questions.why: Sort the numbers first: 15, 17, 23, 37, 46. The middle value (3rd of 5) is 23.
questions.tip: With an odd count, the median is the exact middle value after sorting — don't forget to sort first.

questions.q: The numbers 9, 14, 4, 20, and x have a mean of 16. What is x?
questions.why: The sum of all 5 numbers must be 16 × 5 = 80. The known numbers add to 47, so x = 80 − 47 = 33.
questions.tip: First find the total sum needed (mean × count), then subtract the known values to find the missing one.
